items.title: ENIAC completed
items.description: First general-purpose electronic computer built at Penn

items.title: ARPANET launched
items.description: First packet-switched network, precursor to the Internet

items.title: World Wide Web invented
items.description: Tim Berners-Lee proposes the Web at CERN

items.title: iPhone released
items.description: Apple launches the modern smartphone era

fact: These four milestones span 60 years of computing, from room-sized machines to pocket-sized devices connecting billions of people.
